L2.summary: Publishers and topics are right but details are largely constructed, consistent with the model's prior pattern. Entry 1 (Barth-Kahn OFR WP 21-01) is fully real (extra JFE venue and TRACE data claims unsupported). Entries 2, 4 and 5 are real FEDS Notes with the wrong URL pattern (.htm, wrong dates) and wrong or partly wrong author lists and, for #2, a constructed title (real: 'Sizing hedge funds' Treasury market activities and holdings'). Entry 3's URL points at an unrelated BIS article; the real Sept 2023 item is Box A 'Margin leverage and vulnerabilities in US Treasury futures' by Avalos and Sushko (authors swapped with the 2019 Avalos-Ehlers-Eren repo box).
